description: WattCoin: Claim a slot on a SwarmSolve bounty to unlock its full project spec. Limits apply: a cap on claims per bounty and on active claims per wallet, a GitHub account of minimum age with a public repo, and a minimum WATT balance in the wallet. Re-claiming returns the spec again. There is no submit tool: deliver by opening a PR on the bounty's target_repo that references the issue and puts your wallet in the PR body; the requester approves the winning PR.

github_username.description: Your GitHub username, e.g. octocat; the account must meet the age and repo requirements

wallet.description: Solana wallet address, base58, 32-44 characters (e.g. 7vvNk...). Holds the minimum WATT balance and receives the payout
